custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the bandage and the thumb. In AI images, objects wrapped around limbs often show 'melting' or incorrect occlusion boundaries. Verify if the bandage logically wraps *around* the thumb or if it looks pasted on top. Also, consider that the low resolution might mask fine-grained texture defects; rely more on structural coherence than texture details.
